problem: AdaptFormer fine-tune val/test F1 near 0 (Day5 best_val_f1=0.0001, test=0.0025)

root_causes.title: Empty GT labels in train
root_causes.detail: 5 train pairs had all-zero masks (delhi_0002/0007/0010/0013/0014). Model was rewarded for predicting no change.

root_causes.title: Wrong loss for 2-class head
root_causes.detail: AdaptFormer logits are (N,2,H,W). Training used BCE on softmax change-channel; CE with class weights is correct for this head.

root_causes.title: Eval threshold 0.5 unreachable
root_causes.detail: On Delhi Sentinel crops, hub/finetuned max change-prob is ~0.06–0.14 (mean ~1e-4). Threshold 0.5 yields empty masks → F1=0.

root_causes.title: Only top-left 256 crop from 300px images
root_causes.detail: stride=128 on 300px yields a single top-left tile; change elsewhere was never trained on.

root_causes.title: Domain + data scale
root_causes.detail: LEVIR (~0.5m buildings) vs Delhi 10m Sentinel; only ~22 tiles. Structural limit until more/better labels or GPU + more data.

fixes_implemented: --preset fix: CrossEntropy + pos_weight, exclude empty GT, full-image 256 resize, val-calibrated threshold
Inference uses threshold.json / ADAPTFORMER_THRESHOLD instead of fixed ~0.32-0.5
retrain: python scripts/build_delhi_cd_splits.py --min-change-frac 0.001 && python scripts/finetune_adaptformer.py --delhi-cd data/delhi_cd --preset fix --out runs/finetune_fix
